fichas.title: Passenger Lifts for Residential Buildings
fichas.summary: Guidance on passenger lifts in residential buildings, including load capacities, lift-lobby layout, and shaft, door, car, and machine-room requirements. The guidelines are based on German standards; the text also notes UK lift installation coverage under BS 5655.
